meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Removes AI-generated code smells from branch changes or an explicit file list behind regression tests. Use when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 AI 生成的冗余代码清理干净,再用回归测试确保功能没被改坏
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常用 AI 写代码,想清理留下的坏味道又怕改坏功能
copy.tagline_en: Clean up redundant AI-written code, then run regression tests to confirm nothing broke
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code with AI often and want to remove the resulting smells without breaking things

howto.what: Claude 会先写回归测试锁住现有行为，再按九类「AI 味」问题清理指定改动文件，最后过质量门禁与关键评审；验证不通过就回退或直接修改。
howto.when: 当你要求清理、deslop 或移除最近改动里的 AI-slop 模式时触发；默认范围是分支相对 main 的 diff，也可由调用方传入文件列表。

say.text: 帮我 deslop 一下当前分支的改动
say.note: 先锁测试，再清理分支 diff

say.text: 清理 src/foo.py 的 AI 味代码，行为别变
say.note: 按九类逐项清理并验证

say.text: 把这次改动里的死代码和冗余注释清掉
say.note: 按最安全到最高风险的顺序处理

howto.what_en: Claude first pins current behavior with regression tests, then cleans AI-slop categories from the in-scope changed files, then runs quality gates and a critical review; on failed verification it reverts or edits directly.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes. Default scope is the branch diff vs main; a file list can also be passed in.

say_en.text: Deslop the current branch changes for me
say_en.note: Locks tests, then cleans the branch diff

say_en.text: Clean AI slop from src/foo.py without changing behavior
say_en.note: Cleans the nine categories, then verifies

say_en.text: Remove dead code and obvious comments from this change
